prompt:
A single hero illustration of Bamboo, the HerbLens panda mascot, shown in his signature friendly pose. He is standing upright on two short stubby legs, slightly tilted toward the viewer with his weight on one foot. His round tummy is forward, arms out to his sides with paws open in a gentle welcoming gesture — one paw held a little higher than the other as if mid-wave. His gaze is directly at the viewer: big glossy black eyes, each with ONE crisp symmetric white highlight; solid pink blush circles on both cheeks; a gentle curved closed-mouth smile (no teeth). One small bamboo-leaf tip peeks from behind each ear. 

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern app-mascot illustration, like a premium iOS app icon. Flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradient shading (2-3 shade steps, airbrushed falloff). NO painterly brushstrokes, NO paper grain, NO watercolor texture, NO sketchy lines. The silhouette is a clean confident shape that reads instantly at thumbnail size. A very subtle darker ambient-occlusion contour under the arms and belly adds soft depth, but there is NO hard black outline around the body. Warm single-source light from upper left creates a soft highlight on the top of his head, ears, and the top of his tummy; a gentle core shadow on the lower body. The character occupies about 70 percent of the frame height, centered, with comfortable margins on all sides (no cropping of ears, paws, or feet). This is the canonical Bamboo pose — every other mascot asset is judged against this reference for character consistency.
